svg.text: ADRIATA HEADLAND & THE SUMMER PALACE GROUNDS
Master site-plan of the island-city in its half-moon bay · palace summit, harbour, gardens, cove and the western cliff villa
Dragonbound Cartographic Suite · Plate II of IV
Drawn for the Autumn delegation · Vanserra household copy
I. THE ISLAND-CITY OF ADRIATA — SITE PLAN

g.text: SOUTH CHANNEL · deep water · ship lane
due west-north-west, low over the water
palace & villa drawn at twice scale for legibility
Back wing — still in ruin since Amarantha
Guest Wing — suites round a sea-lounge
North Bridge — the delegation's way in
South Drawbridge over the ship lane
Tide-Temple — causeway bare at low tide
The Teeth — reef that keeps hulls off
Pearl Market & the upper city stair
canon = from the books · ⚑ = devised for this table
◆ The lie of the land. A tan-stone palace on a mountain-island in the heart of a
half-moon bay; the mainland circles it on three sides and the west lies open to
◆ Three bridges. All traffic funnels over them. The east and south spans raise for
ships, and a raised span cuts the island off within minutes.
◆ The delegation's way in. Coast road from the Salt-Lantern, North Bridge, the
upper city stair, then the Arrival Court and its sea-glass doors.
◆ The villa stands apart. One causeway, two guard posts, and a west cliff with no
beach beneath it. Whoever comes to the Salt-Arch comes announced.
◆ Prince's corridor. The cavern mouth faces west-north-west. The Teeth keep
hulls a quarter-mile off, the palace mass blocks the city, and the nearest scryer
post is on the far north shore.
◆ Where he is seen. Above 60 m, or anywhere east of the summit, he is in view of
the whole harbour. Fly at dusk, low, and turn only beyond the reef.
◆ Slipping away. The gardens fall south-west to the private cove. The Tide Stair is
overlooked by nothing but the guest-wing balconies.
